name: Armed-group territory or sanctioned parties in conflict areas
description: Trade, production or payments involve territories controlled by armed groups or parties linked to them.
fp: Legitimate suppliers and humanitarian actors operate in affected regions.

sources.text: FATF, Money Laundering from Environmental Crime (2021)
OECD, OECD Due Diligence Guidance for Responsible Supply Chains of Minerals from Conflict-Affected and High-Risk Areas, Third Edition (2016)
FATF and APG, Money Laundering and Terrorist Financing Risks and Vulnerabilities Associated with Gold (2015)
UN Security Council expert panel reports on illicit mineral trade
FATF, Financing of the Terrorist Organisation Islamic State in Iraq and the Levant (ISIL) (2015)
FATF, Financing of Recruitment for Terrorist Purposes (2018)
FATF, Terrorist Financing Risk Assessment Guidance (2019)

links.name: Links to armed groups or sanctioned parties in conflict areas
links.ctx: Mining or trade in territories controlled by armed groups with payments to checkpoints.

links.name: Commodity trade originating from areas controlled by armed groups
links.ctx: Shipments of oil, minerals, scrap or agricultural goods with origin documentation tied to territory where terrorist groups operate.
links.fp: Legitimate producers in border regions can have mixed supply chains.
